title: The Pure White Sweet Pea Sways Gently

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —The Snow Princess is in full bloom. Hehe, wonderfully pure white. The tiny flowers curl into little rounds, just like pom-poms.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The pansies should be ready to bloom soon, too— 
Let's move them somewhere with a bit more sunlight.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Watering, done. Next up — picking out flowers to decorate the classroom. Please share a few of your roses with me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
And then — oh. The sweet peas are already blooming. 
If I pair them together, it'll look more vibrant. As for the color — I think white would be nice.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, how cute. I hope everyone gives you lots of attention. 
—Oh. Sparkling in the morning sun……

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Like a tiny, golden bouquet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (Elegant roses, with the frills of sweet peas. Bundle their unique charms together in harmony, and — a cheerfully dancing bouquet is complete.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (Flowers, and races too. Each of their colors comes together in harmony, and shines all the brighter. That special kind of beauty — I love it.)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Fufuun～♪ The long-awaited mock race is finally here! 
I can't wait for our turn to come around!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Gran, if you skip around like that, won't you wear yourself out before the race even begins?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: This is just MiRule!, y'know! Whenever I'm itching to run, I skip!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: 『Woah, she's super fired up～! But Maru and Loves have been doing secret training too, right!』

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yeah～♪ Gran isn't the only one who's been looking forward to today's mock race, you know.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: It seems everyone has prepared thoroughly, even for a mock race. W-We should do our best too…… so we don't get overwhelmed……!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Yes. I'll run with all I have. 
Let's both do our best out there.

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next up, Group D! 
……Good, gate-in complete!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(—I've secured a forward position. 
Chrono is nearby, and Loves and the others are further back.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(The pace is a little fast. At this rate, the final stretch will be tough. I need to maintain my own pace, without getting 
swept up—)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I won't let you control the pace. 
I'll mark you and keep the pressure on……!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So Maru's going from the inside, huh. 
—Then I'll take the outside!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (From both sides—! Ugh…… The gap ahead keeps narrowing. Forcing my way through there would be…… Then, to the outside—)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Even from the far outside, I can push past them—!! 
Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (I can't go outside either — I just have to wait for the gap to open up ahead……)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ——! Right here! Yaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text: Bouquet, you need to make your move the moment a gap opens up. You have to be aggressive and secure your own space! That fighting spirit is what leads to victory!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Yes…… Thank you for the guidance.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
U-Um…… Bouquet, I'm sorry…… 
Did I…… put too much pressure on you……?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, that's not it! It's simply — a matter of my own feelings… The thought crossed my mind that cutting in might cause you trouble…

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Honestly, you're too kind. It's very much like you, Bouquet, but… everyone's used to it by now. With a gap that size, we fully expect someone to take it!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
L-Loves is right……! 
Besides, racing… and competing is just like that.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes…… Thank you both for your consideration.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (Fighting fiercely for position, and seizing victory. Cutting into a gap to secure your path forward — that's part of competing, too.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (But — I always end up hesitating, every time……)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me. Um, to all the trainers here, would it be alright, if I changed the water for the flowers?
choice_data_list: Ah, it's you. Thanks as always!
Ah, it's you. Thanks as always!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Oh, no, I'm just sharing some of the classroom's flowers with the trainers' break room — but, you're welcome.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ……Ah, the roses I brought two days ago are still blooming beautifully. Paired with these flowers I brought today — I think red right in the center would look lovely.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (—Red roses. Passionate flowers, just like Loves. They have such a strong presence, and yet, when bundled with other flowers — it harmonize so perfectly.)

text_block_list.name: Young Bouquet
text_block_list.text:
Curren, do your best～! Wow, so fast……! 
You can do it, you can do it, just a little more……! 
—Yay, she won!

text_block_list.name: Young Bouquet
text_block_list.text: Hehe, Curren and the others are all sparkling so brightly. Racing makes everyone come together as one — just like a bouquet.

text_block_list.name: Young Bouquet
text_block_list.text: It's so beautiful…… I want to become part of the bouquet too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone's feelings collide, creating the "harmony" of a race. Captivated by the harmony that Curren and the others showed me — 
I began to run.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (But — I can't push forward. Unable to aggressively pursue victory, I — might be disrupting the "harmony" of the race……)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (—I can't match that same passion. I just end up creating disharmony. ……Maybe I…… should quit—)
choice_data_list: What's wrong? You looked a little spaced out…… Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ah! I-I'm sorry! I'm fine…… I'll rearrange the flowers right away! —I'll go change the water, too!
choice_data_list: <size=38>Um… Before that. Here, have some coffee</size>

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Coffee, and even sweets to go with it. 
Is it really alright for me to accept so much?
choice_data_list: <size=38>Because your flowers give me so much comfort</size>

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (I'm so happy…… You always thank me, Trainer. And you didn't just notice the flowers — you said they brought you comfort.)
choice_data_list: <size=32>Are those sweet peas? They're so lovely and vibrant</size>
<size=32>Are those sweet peas? They're so lovely and vibrant</size>

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right. Their fluttering petals look like frills, right? Hehehe, so vibrant and lovely.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: That's why they're so wonderful for flower arrangements. Adding sweet peas brings movement and makes everything instantly more vibrant.
choice_data_list: <size=32>It's true, it seems like your mood brightened up a bit too</size>
<size=32>It's true, it seems like your mood brightened up a bit too</size>

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ……Eh? Ah—……

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(—Did they speak to me because I looked so troubled? 
Could it be — this coffee, too……?)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
……Hehe, it's thanks to the flowers, and the coffee. 
It was so warm — it made even my heart soften into bloom.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—Sorry, got a minute? 
There's something I'd like to ask of you—
